version.description: The schema version of the configuration.

default_view.description: The default DataViews configuration for the screen: layout type, visible fields, sorting, filtering, and pagination.

type.description: The layout type, one of `table`, `grid`, `list`, `activity`, `pickerGrid`, or `pickerTable`.

default_layouts.description: The layout types the user can switch between, and the view overrides each one applies.

table.description: View overrides applied when the table layout is selected.

list.description: View overrides applied when the list layout is selected.

grid.description: View overrides applied when the grid layout is selected.

activity.description: View overrides applied when the activity layout is selected.

pickerGrid.description: View overrides applied when the grid layout of a picker (DataViewsPicker) is selected.

pickerTable.description: View overrides applied when the table layout of a picker (DataViewsPicker) is selected.

view_list.description: The preconfigured views displayed in the screen's sidebar.

title.description: Title of the view, displayed in the sidebar.

slug.description: Unique identifier for the view. Used as the member identity when merging patches.

view.description: Partial view configuration applied on top of `default_view` when the view is selected — typically locked `filters`, but any view property works. Optional.

type.description: The layout type, one of `table`, `grid`, `list`, `activity`, `pickerGrid`, or `pickerTable`.

form.description: The DataForm configuration for the Quick Edit form: which fields are displayed, in which order, and how each one is laid out.

fields.description: The fields of the form, in display order. Each entry is a field id, or an object for further configuration.

filters.description: Filters applied to the dataset. A filter with `isLocked` set cannot be changed or removed by the user.

operator.description: The operator to use, one of `is`, `isNot`, `isAny`, `isNone`, `isAll`, `isNotAll`, `lessThan`, `greaterThan`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `before`, or `after`.

isLocked.description: Whether the filter is locked. A locked filter cannot be changed or removed by the user.

sort.description: The default sort: the field id and the direction (`asc` or `desc`).

direction.description: The direction to sort by, `asc` or `desc`.

perPage.description: Number of records per page. Also used as the batch size when infinite scroll is enabled.

fields.description: Ids of the fields that are visible, in display order.

titleField.description: Id of the field used as the record title.

mediaField.description: Id of the field used as the record media (e.g. featured image or preview).

descriptionField.description: Id of the field used as the record description.

showTitle.description: Whether the title is shown. Defaults to `true`.

showMedia.description: Whether the media is shown. Defaults to `true`.

showDescription.description: Whether the description is shown. Defaults to `true`.

showLevels.description: Whether to display hierarchical levels for the records (e.g. child pages indented under their parent). Defaults to `false`.

groupBy.description: The grouping configuration: the field to group by, the direction (`asc` or `desc`), and whether to show the field label in each group header (`showLabel`, defaults to `true`).

direction.description: The direction to sort the groups by, `asc` or `desc`.

showLabel.description: Whether to show the field label in the group header.

infiniteScrollEnabled.description: Whether infinite scroll is enabled instead of pagination.

columnStyle.description: The style of a single field column.

width.description: The width of the field column, as a CSS value or a number of pixels.

maxWidth.description: The maximum width of the field column, as a CSS value or a number of pixels.

minWidth.description: The minimum width of the field column, as a CSS value or a number of pixels.

align.description: The alignment of the field column: `start`, `center`, or `end`. Defaults to `start`.

styles.description: The styles for the columns, keyed by field id. Each column style accepts `width`, `maxWidth`, and `minWidth` (a CSS value or a number of pixels) and `align` (`start`, `center`, or `end`).

density.description: The density of the layout: `compact`, `balanced`, or `comfortable`.

enableMoving.description: Whether the user can reorder columns.

density.description: The density of the layout: `compact`, `balanced`, or `comfortable`.

badgeFields.description: Ids of the fields to display as badges instead of regular fields.

previewSize.description: The preview size of the grid.

density.description: The density of the grid layout: `compact`, `balanced`, or `comfortable`.

combinedLayout.description: Configuration specific to the selected layout type. Accepts the `layout` options of any layout type; see [`default_layouts`](#default_layouts).

density.description: The density of the layout: `compact`, `balanced`, or `comfortable`.

formLayout.description: The layout used to render the form fields, discriminated by its `type`. See the form layout types.

oneOf.description: The default layout: the field controls are rendered directly in the form, one after another.

labelPosition.description: Position of the field label: `top`, `side`, or `none`.

oneOf.description: The field is rendered as a button that opens a dropdown or modal with the field controls.

labelPosition.description: Position of the field label: `top`, `side`, or `none`.

openAs.description: How the panel opens: as a `dropdown` or as a `modal`. The object form allows customizing the labels of the modal buttons.

oneOf.description: The type of container to open, `dropdown` or `modal`.
The type of container to open, with custom labels for the modal buttons.

type.description: The type of container to open, `dropdown` or `modal`.

applyLabel.description: Label of the modal button that applies the changes.

cancelLabel.description: Label of the modal button that discards the changes.

summary.description: Id(s) of the field(s) whose values are rendered in the panel button.

editVisibility.description: When the edit button is visible: `always` or `on-hover`.

oneOf.description: The fields are grouped in a card container.

withHeader.description: Whether the card renders a header. Defaults to `true`.

isOpened.description: Whether the card content is opened. Defaults to `true`.

isCollapsible.description: Whether the card can be collapsed by the user.

summary.description: Id(s) of the field(s) whose values are rendered in the card header. An entry declared as an object controls when it is visible: `always` or `when-collapsed`.

oneOf.description: A list of field ids, optionally with their visibility.
A field id with its visibility.

visibility.description: When the field value is visible in the card header: `always` or `when-collapsed`.

oneOf.description: The fields are rendered horizontally in a single row.

alignment.description: Vertical alignment of the fields in the row: `start`, `center`, or `end`.

styles.description: The styles for the fields in the row, keyed by field id. Each style accepts a `flex` value controlling how the field grows or shrinks.

flex.description: The CSS `flex` value for the field.

oneOf.description: The fields are rendered inside a collapsible disclosure (details) element.

summary.description: Label displayed as the summary of the disclosure element.

formField.description: A form field: a field id, or an object for further configuration.

oneOf.description: A form field with additional configuration.

id.description: Id of the field. Used as the member identity when merging patches.

label.description: Label displayed for the field, overriding the field's own.

children.description: Fields combined under this entry, following the same shape as `fields`.

oneOf.description: A nested form field, following the same shape as an object entry of `fields`.
